name: Tokido
source:
Side character of episode 2
One of the members from the vigilante selected by [url=/c92659]Nishima[/url] to assist [url=/c92637]Rei[/url] and [url=/c92638]Aruru[/url] in their mountain exploration trip.
A man with bright dyed hair even at his old age. Tokido was under the same situation as [url=/c92659]Nishima[/url] regarding his early life, and was taken care of by [url=/c92661]Ginji[/url] afterward.
